sub_graphs.title: Deneb Beacon Chain: Blob KZG Commitment Processing
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of blob KZG commitments from block receipt through validation and header caching in the beacon chain

nodes.label: Beacon Block with Blob Commitments Received
nodes.description: A beacon block containing blob_kzg_commitments in its body has been received

nodes.label: Validate Blob Commitment Count
nodes.description: Check that len(body.blob_kzg_commitments) <= MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK (6)

nodes.label: Convert Commitments to Versioned Hashes
nodes.description: Transform each KZG commitment into a versioned hash by prepending VERSIONED_HASH_VERSION_KZG (0x01) and hashing

nodes.label: Validate Versioned Hashes Against EL
nodes.description: Call is_valid_versioned_hashes to ensure blob transaction commitments in the execution payload match the beacon block commitments

nodes.label: Blob Commitments Validated
nodes.description: All blob KZG commitments have been validated for count and consistency with execution payload

nodes.label: Cache Blob Gas Metrics in Header
nodes.description: Store blob_gas_used and excess_blob_gas from execution payload into the latest execution payload header

nodes.label: Execution Payload Header Updated
nodes.description: The beacon state's latest execution payload header now includes blob gas metrics

edges.label: Block proposer broadcasts block with blob commitments
Count valid, convert to versioned hashes
Header updated with blob gas fields

external_entities.name: Block Proposer
external_entities.description: The validator proposing a beacon block containing blob KZG commitments

sub_graphs.title: Deneb Beacon Chain: Extended Attestation Inclusion Window
sub_graphs.description: Models the modified attestation validation rules in Deneb that extend the inclusion window and change participation flag behavior

nodes.label: Attestation Received for Processing
nodes.description: An attestation has been included in a block and is being processed

nodes.label: Validate Extended Inclusion Window
nodes.description: Check that attestation slot + MIN_ATTESTATION_INCLUSION_DELAY <= current slot, with valid slots spanning target epoch and next epoch (EIP-7045)

nodes.label: Set Participation Flags
nodes.description: Set TIMELY_TARGET_FLAG for any correct target attestation regardless of inclusion delay; set other flags based on timeliness

nodes.label: Attestation Participation Recorded
nodes.description: Attestation participation flags have been updated in the beacon state

nodes.label: Attestation Rejected
nodes.description: Attestation failed inclusion window or other validation checks

sub_graphs.title: Deneb Beacon Chain: Execution Engine Interface with Beacon Root
sub_graphs.description: Models the trust boundary between consensus and execution layers in Deneb, including the new parent beacon block root parameter (EIP-4788)

nodes.label: Execution Payload Pending Validation
nodes.description: An execution payload from a beacon block needs to be validated by the execution engine

nodes.label: Build NewPayloadRequest
nodes.description: Construct the request with execution_payload, versioned_hashes from blob commitments, and parent_beacon_block_root

nodes.label: Notify New Payload to Execution Engine
nodes.description: Send the NewPayloadRequest to the execution engine for validation via the Engine API

nodes.label: Execution Payload Validated
nodes.description: Execution engine has confirmed the payload is valid including versioned hash consistency

nodes.label: Execution Payload Invalid
nodes.description: Execution engine has rejected the payload

external_entities.name: Execution Engine
external_entities.description: The execution layer client validating payloads and blob versioned hashes via Engine API

sub_graphs.title: Deneb Beacon Chain: Validator Activation Churn Limit
sub_graphs.description: Models the new per-epoch activation churn limit (EIP-7514) that caps the rate of validator activations

nodes.label: Validators Pending Activation
nodes.description: Validators in the activation queue waiting to be activated during epoch processing

nodes.label: Compute Activation Churn Limit
nodes.description: Calculate min(MAX_PER_EPOCH_ACTIVATION_CHURN_LIMIT (8), computed_churn_limit) to determine maximum activations this epoch

nodes.label: Dequeue Validators for Activation
nodes.description: Activate validators from the queue up to the activation churn limit

nodes.label: Validators Activated
nodes.description: Selected validators have been activated and are now part of the active validator set

sub_graphs.title: Deneb Beacon Chain: Perpetual Voluntary Exit Signatures
sub_graphs.description: Models the modified voluntary exit signature validation that uses a fixed fork version (EIP-7044)

nodes.label: Voluntary Exit Received
nodes.description: A signed voluntary exit has been included in a block

nodes.label: Validate Exit with Fixed Fork Version
nodes.description: Validate the exit signature using CAPELLA_FORK_VERSION domain instead of current fork version, enabling perpetually valid signatures

nodes.label: Voluntary Exit Valid
nodes.description: Exit signature and conditions verified, validator begins exit process

nodes.label: Voluntary Exit Invalid
nodes.description: Exit signature verification failed

edges.label: Signature valid under fixed fork version

ambiguities.text: MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK is 4096 but MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK is 6. The relationship between these two limits is not immediately clear from the spec text.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK is a protocol-level maximum for the SSZ list container, while MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK is the practical per-block limit enforced during validation. The validation check uses MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK.

ambiguities.text: The spec says TIMELY_TARGET_FLAG is set for 'any correct target attestation, regardless of inclusion delay' but does not clearly define the boundary between 'correct target' and other validity conditions.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'correct target' means the attestation's target checkpoint matches the expected checkpoint for the target epoch, independent of when the attestation was included.

ambiguities.text: Using CAPELLA_FORK_VERSION for voluntary exit signatures means exits signed before Capella would need to have anticipated this version.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume EIP-7044 only applies to exits processed during or after Deneb. Exits signed with Capella fork version during the Capella epoch are already valid, and the perpetual validity extends forward from Deneb.

implicit_assumptions.description: The execution engine correctly validates versioned hashes and reports accurate blob_gas_used and excess_blob_gas values.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect blob gas accounting could lead to mispriced blob transactions, enabling spam attacks or economic manipulation of the blob fee market.

implicit_assumptions.description: The KZG trusted setup ceremony was performed honestly and the toxic waste was destroyed.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A compromised trusted setup would allow forging KZG proofs, enabling submission of arbitrary data as valid blobs and undermining data availability guarantees.

implicit_assumptions.description: The MAX_PER_EPOCH_ACTIVATION_CHURN_LIMIT of 8 is sufficient to prevent rapid validator set changes while still allowing reasonable onboarding.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If the limit is too low, legitimate validators may face excessive queue times. If bypassed, rapid validator churn could destabilize consensus.
